title: Micronutrition as a Therapeutic Strategy for Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome and Fibromyalgia: A Narrative Review.
intervention: Mitochondrial-targeted micronutrient supplementation (NAD+ precursors, B-complex vitamins, magnesium, coenzyme Q10, alpha-lipoic acid, GlyNAC, L-carnitine, pyrroloquinoline quinone, taurine, creatine)

outcomes.name: clinical efficacy of mitochondrial-oriented micronutritional interventions
outcomes.effect_text: disease-specific randomized controlled evidence remains limited for several interventions
